spells.name: Thwip
spells.description: While wielding an Cunning weapon, you can burn any card to sling a magic attack at an enemy and deal 1hp of Damage.

spells.name: Arcane Bell
spells.description: While wielding an Cunning weapon or Holy Symbol, you can burn any card to sling a magic attack at an enemy.  They must make a Spirit Saving throw. On a failure it deals 1hp of Damage.

spells.name: Arcane Light
spells.description: Create a small floating magical light that illuminates the surrounding area. The light follows you until the duration ends or you dismiss it.

spells.name: Divine Sign
spells.description: Create a harmless, visible sign of your faith such as a glowing symbol, whispered prayer, or brief holy radiance.

spells.name: Primal Whisper
spells.description: Produce a harmless natural effect such as rustling leaves, a faint animal call, a small breeze, or the scent of a nearby plant.

spells.name: Occult Mark
spells.description: Place a harmless supernatural mark on an object or surface. The mark is visible only to creatures capable of perceiving magical effects.

spells.name: Firebolt
spells.channel: Yes — Burn additional Diamonds after casting. Each additional Diamond deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Hurl a bolt of magical fire at an enemy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 1 HP damage.

spells.name: Healing Touch
spells.description: Restore 2 HP to an ally you can touch.

spells.name: Healing Call
spells.description: Restore 1 HP to an ally you can see.

spells.name: Primal Snare
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Roots, vines, or grasping natural energy restrain an enemy. The enemy must make a Dexterity Saving throw. On a failure, the target's movement is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Whispering Curse
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Whisper a fragment of supernatural dread into an enemy's mind. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, the target suffers -1 on its next attack.

spells.name: Arcane Burst
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Release a concentrated blast of magical energy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 3 HP damage.

spells.name: Blessing of Courage
spells.description: Bless an ally with supernatural courage. The target gains +1 Spirit until the next Long Rest.

spells.name: Beast Strength
spells.description: Infuse an ally with primal strength. The target gains +1 Might until the next Long Rest.

spells.name: Shadow Grasp
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Spectral shadows seize an enemy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 2 HP damage and prevent the target from taking Reactions until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage to the primary target.
spells.description: Lightning leaps from your hand into an enemy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 4 HP damage. A second nearby enemy takes 2 HP damage.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.description: Restore 5 HP to an ally and end one ongoing harmful magical effect affecting them.

spells.name: Wildshape
spells.duration: Until next Long Rest or dismissed
spells.description: Transform into a powerful natural form. Gain +2 Might and +1 HP, but you cannot use weapons or cast spells while transformed.

spells.name: Spectral Bind
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Spectral chains bind an enemy in place. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 3 HP damage and prevent the target from moving.

spells.name: Meteor
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Call down a devastating fragment of celestial fire. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 7 HP damage to the target and 3 HP damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Divine Sanctuary
spells.description: Surround an ally with protective divine power. The target cannot lose HP from the next attack that hits them.

spells.name: Ancient Titan
spells.description: Invoke the strength of an ancient primal giant. Gain +3 Might and increase your maximum HP by 3 for the duration.

spells.name: Nightmare
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Flood an enemy's mind with supernatural terror. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 5 HP damage and the target cannot willingly move toward you until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Arcane Apocalypse
spells.channel: Yes — Each additional Diamond Burned after casting deals +1 damage.
spells.description: Unleash an overwhelming eruption of arcane energy. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 10 HP damage to the target and 5 HP damage to every nearby enemy.

spells.name: Miracle
spells.description: Call upon overwhelming divine power. Restore an ally to full HP and end all harmful conditions and magical effects affecting them.

spells.name: Avatar of the Wild
spells.description: Become a towering avatar of primal power. Gain +3 Might, +2 Dexterity, +5 HP, and your successful attacks deal +2 damage.

spells.name: Death's Command
spells.duration: Until end of target's next turn
spells.description: Command the boundary between life and death. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 8 HP damage. If the target is reduced to 0 HP, you may immediately restore 3 HP to an ally within Near range.

spells.name: Phantom Key
spells.description: Create a temporary magical key that fits one simple mundane lock. It cannot open magical locks.

spells.name: Whispered Prayer
spells.description: Send a quiet encouraging message to an ally within Near range that only they can hear.

spells.name: Primal Scent
spells.description: Create a harmless natural scent. You may imitate the smell of an animal, plant, food, or other familiar natural substance.

spells.name: Occult Echo
spells.description: Cause an object to repeat the last few words spoken near it, provided the words were spoken within the last minute.

spells.name: Arcane Message
spells.description: Send a short whispered message to a creature you can identify within Far range.

spells.name: Divine Guidance
spells.description: Bless an ally with divine guidance. The next skill check they make gains an appropriate benefit determined by the GM.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.description: A magical vine lashes an enemy. Make a Dexterity magic attack. On a hit, deal 1 HP damage and pull the target toward you.

spells.name: Whisper to the Dead
spells.description: Ask a nearby dead creature or lingering spirit one simple question. The spirit may answer if it is able and willing.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense magical effects, enchanted objects, and active spells within Near range. You can identify the general domain of magic detected.

spells.name: Sanctify
spells.description: Bless an object or small area. Undead and other supernatural creatures may recognize it as a place of divine power.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Create illusory duplicates around yourself. The first attack against you each round may be confused or redirected by the GM.

spells.name: Divine Aid
spells.description: Bless up to two allies. Each gains 1 temporary HP and advantage on one check involving courage, fear, or resisting supernatural influence.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: Gain the senses of a nearby animal. You may perceive through the animal's senses while remaining aware of your own surroundings.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.description: Teleport from one area of dim light or darkness to another within Near range.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.description: Create an invisible magical servant capable of carrying objects, opening simple doors, cleaning, retrieving items, or performing other simple physical tasks.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: When a creature within Near range casts a spell, interrupt it. Burn the normal cost of Counterspell and make a Cunning magic attack against the caster. On a hit, the spell fails.

spells.name: Mass Healing
spells.description: Restore 3 HP to up to three allies within Near range.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.channel: Yes — Burn additional Clubs to strike additional nearby targets.
spells.description: Call lightning from the sky. Make a Dexterity magic attack. On a hit, deal 4 HP damage. Additional resonant Clubs may strike additional nearby targets.

spells.name: Shadow Walk
spells.description: Step into one shadow and emerge from another location within Far range that you can perceive.

spells.name: Zone of Truth
spells.description: Create a sacred area where deliberate lies become difficult to speak. Creatures may still refuse to answer or attempt to deceive through technically true statements.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Teleport yourself and willing creatures you can touch to a location you know. The GM determines whether the destination is sufficiently familiar and safe.

spells.name: Life Restored
spells.description: Restore an ally who has fallen unconscious to 5 HP. This spell cannot restore a creature that has been dead for an extended period.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.channel: Yes — Burn additional Clubs to increase the wall's length or duration.
spells.description: Create a dense wall of magical thorns that blocks movement. Creatures forcing their way through suffer 2 HP damage.

spells.name: Memory Walk
spells.description: Enter the surface memories of a willing or incapacitated creature. You may observe a recent memory or discover information the creature consciously remembers.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: Become invisible while retaining the ability to act normally. The effect ends if the GM determines that an unusual magical effect reveals you.

spells.name: Reality Break
spells.channel: Yes — Burn additional Diamonds to expand the affected area.
spells.description: Tear open a violent rift of magical force. Make a Cunning magic attack against creatures in the area. On a hit, deal 8 HP damage and dramatically alter the terrain.

spells.name: Mass Restoration
spells.description: Restore every ally within Near range to full HP and remove one major harmful condition from each target.

spells.name: Storm Avatar
spells.channel: Yes — Burn additional Clubs to increase damage or affect additional enemies.
spells.description: Transform into an avatar of wind, rain, and lightning. You gain powerful movement through the air and your attacks deal +2 HP damage.

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.description: Trap an enemy's spirit within a supernatural prison. Make a Cunning magic attack. On a hit, deal 6 HP damage and prevent the target from willingly leaving its current area.

spells.name: Divine Intervention
spells.description: Call upon overwhelming divine power to accomplish a single extraordinary but thematically appropriate miracle. The GM determines the exact scope and consequences.
